entries.title: Choose on a plan which parts get a careful review
entries.body: A plan with more than one part now lists every part with a tick box for a careful review. The parts your crewmate recommends arrive ticked, with a reason beside each, and you can untick any of them. When you approve the plan, each ticked part is built as a careful change and the rest at your project's usual care.
entries.noPicture: Your crewmate writes this question on its own plan card; no view of the app changes.
